title: Were you planning to buy a home, but decided to hit pause? | CNN Business
text:
Source: CNN

For the past few years, the math of buying a home in the United States has been tough: low inventory, high mortgage rates and record-high prices have made homeownership increasingly expensive.

Earlier this year, there was hope that the housing affordability picture might finally be improving. Mortgage rates briefly fell below 6% for the first time in three years, offering prospective buyers some relief. But that was short-lived. Rates have climbed steadily since the US began its war against Iran in February, with the average 30-year mortgage rate hittingthe highest level of 2026last week.

Signs suggest many Americans have stepped back from the housing market. In July, Redfinreportedthat home-showing activity was growing at a slower pace than it had been just one year earlier. In August, only 5.2% of consumers said they planned to buy a home within the next six months,accordingto the Conference Board – the lowest reading in five years.
